trades.thesis: Insiders (EGI/Ventas) sold 8M shares at 14.50, an 18% discount to the 17.75 close. The stock gapped down 22.5% on supply, not on company news, and closed 14.40 (0.88 of range) on 8.9x volume. Q3 beat, FY EBITDA guide raised and PTs of 18-22 are intact. Company is buying back 1.5M shares at the offer price and underwriters hold a 30-day greenshoe, so 14.50 should act as support. Overhang is cleared and the supply-driven gap should partly retrace.
trades.wrong_if: ARDT closes below the 13.46 offering-day low, or hospital-sector selling from the CRUSH rule drags it down despite the cleared overhang.
